footer.terms.note: MT returned an imperative meaning 'comply with the terms of use'. A link label is a noun phrase.

footer.sitemap.note: MT returned 'main headings'. Khareetat al-mawqi is the standard term for a sitemap.

listing.bedsShort.note: Matched to bathsShort for consistency; both are the compact card abbreviations.

listing.bathsShort.note: MT returned nothing: 'ba' is two characters with no context. Arabic has no comparable abbreviation, so the short noun is used.

search.type.land.note: MT returned '# أرض' — a hash invented from nothing, caught by the symmetric check added in #369.

search.filters.area.note: MT returned nothing: 'Area' alone is a single word with no context.

property.stat.bedrooms.note: MT invented a '#'. Plain column header, no count — the counted form lives in listing.bedrooms.

property.faq.locationQ.note: MT returned nothing. Placeholder position moved to suit Arabic word order — which is the point of using a named placeholder rather than concatenating.

property.faq.includesA.note: MT returned nothing on a sentence carrying five placeholders. Hand-authored with the placeholders reordered for Arabic — a fragment-for-fragment port could not have done that.

development.units.orientation.note: MT invented a '#'. Single-word column header, no count.

development.units.plotNumber.note: Flagged hash-dropped, but that is a FALSE POSITIVE: the '#' in "Plot #" is a literal number-sign abbreviation, not ICU's number placeholder. The validator cannot tell them apart, and flagging for a human is the right side to err on.

area.empty.offPlanOnly.note: MT could not do this one. A long sentence with a nested {area} inside six plural branches: at max_tokens 1200 the JSON truncated, and raising it made the model return an explanation of plural rules instead. Hand-authored.

editorial.agent.worksFullCycle.note: MT returned nothing twice. A short sentence whose only content word is a masked proper noun leaves almost nothing to translate.

editorial.agent.mailGreeting.note: MT returned nothing. Same shape — a greeting built almost entirely around a masked name.

forms.sell.summaryIntent.rent_out.note: MT wrote للايجار without the hamza. Same word, standard orthography.

forms.sell.summaryBeds.note: Aligned to listing.bedrooms, which is already reviewed and holds the same noun. MT put the plural غرف in the `many` branch, where 11–99 takes the accusative singular غرفة.

forms.sell.summaryBedsPlus.note: MT returned summaryBeds verbatim and dropped the +, which is the only thing this message exists for. `8+` is an open range, so every branch takes the plural — the count is indeterminate and cannot agree.

forms.sell.summaryArea.note: MT wrote م² — square METRES. The figure is square feet; the form's own input is labelled ft². A wrong unit on an owner's built-up area is a factual error, not a style one.

forms.sell.stepAnnounce.note: Definite article: this announces a specific step in a known sequence.

pages.sell.statListings.note: MT transliterated the brand as بزار. lib/i18n/mt/proper-nouns.ts holds بازار as `official`, sourced from the client's own catalogue. Also إعلانات عقارية, the term the rest of the catalogue uses for listings.

pages.sell.statAreas.note: أبوظبي closed up, matching the rest of the corpus; MT wrote أبو ظبي.

pages.sell.statAdvisors.note: MT rendered 'on the desk' literally as على الطاولة — a physical table — and hung ADREC off the end. مسجّلون لدى ADREC is the phrasing the sell page's own FAQ already uses.
